{{Top|notoc=1}}
The term '''subspecies''' refers to a biologically distinct subdivision of a biological species. The [[Y'bith/Legends|Y'bith]], for example, were a subspecies of the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] species. While obviously similar to other Bith, they differed in their weaker eyesight, more sensitive skin, thicker bones, stronger hands and feet, and ductile mouth structures.<ref name="Y'bith in the Databank">{{DB|species|ybith|Y'bith}}</ref>

A related term was '''race'''. While members of different races within a species were capable of interbreeding and producing viable offspring, members of different species generally could not. In casual discourse, however, the term "race" would often be used where species would be technically correct (especially when referring to different [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species.)<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref>

In addition, it was often difficult to tell if a population was a race, a subspecies, or a distinct species, and the division was often arbitrary or cultural. The [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]], for example, were capable of interbreeding with baseline [[Human/Legends|Humans]], but were referred to both as a race<ref name="Dark Empire Sourcebook">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> and as a distinct species.<ref name="Diva Shaliqua in the Databank">{{DB|character|divashaliqua|Shaliqua, Diva}}</ref>
